entities.summary: María Juliana Ruiz Sandoval is a Colombian lawyer who served as First Lady of Colombia from 2018 to 2022 as the wife of President Iván Duque. Ruiz is the fourth youngest first lady in history after Ana Milena Muñoz de Gaviria, wife of César Gaviria.
